name: Dimension-Filtered Positive Ample Classes Definition
statement: For a finite nonempty ample $C\subseteq Q_X=\{0,1\}^X$, let $I(C)=\{(v,S):v\in C,\ Q(v,S)\subseteq C\}$, where $Q(v,S)$ fixes the coordinates outside $S$ at $v$. The matrix $M_C$ has one row per distinct positioned cube $B\subseteq C$ and entries $M_C(B,(v,S))=\mathbf1\{v\in B,\operatorname{dir}(B)\subseteq S\}$. Write $\mathcal A(C)=\{\mu\ge0:M_C\mu=\mathbf1\}$. There is a real full solution $z$ of $M_Cz=\mathbf1$ with $z(v,S)\ge0$ whenever $|S|\le k$. Coefficients on larger supports are unrestricted.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty ample classes on the full specified ambient cube, including original constant coordinates. Empty complementary shores have the unique empty allocation. Ordinary witnesses are the integral points of the full native allocation system. Integer k >= 0. Fixed levels zero, one and two equal Amp; Pos_3 has its own entry.
